tasks.label: Build Release (Local)
args: source .venv/bin/activate && source project-config.sh && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Release && conan build .

tasks.label: Build Debug (Local)
args: source .venv/bin/activate && source project-config.sh && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Debug && conan build .

tasks.label: Build Release (Docker)
args: source project-config.sh && docker compose run --rm conan-builder bash -c "cd /workspace && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Release && conan build ."

tasks.label: Run Release (Local)
args: source .venv/bin/activate && source project-config.sh && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Release && conan build . && ./build/Release/bin/$TARGET_NAME ${input:runArgs}

tasks.label: Run Release (Docker)
args: source project-config.sh && docker compose run --rm conan-builder bash -c "cd /workspace && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Release && conan build . && ./build/Release/bin/$TARGET_NAME ${input:runArgs}"

tasks.label: Launch (GDB Local Debug)
args: source .venv/bin/activate && source project-config.sh && rm -rf build/Debug/CMakeCache.txt build/Debug/CMakeFiles && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Debug && conan build . && gdb ./build/Debug/bin/$TARGET_NAME

tasks.label: Launch (GDB Docker Debug)
args: source project-config.sh && docker compose run --rm --service-ports conan-builder bash -c "cd /workspace && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Debug && conan build . && gdb ./build/Debug/bin/$TARGET_NAME"
